university_info.name: National University of Bangladesh
university_info.headquarters: Board Bazar, Gazipur 1704, Dhaka Division, Bangladesh
university_info.nature: Affiliating university with over 2,250 colleges across Bangladesh providing tertiary education.

modules.topic_bn: ফলাফল ও রেজাল্ট আর্কাইভ দেখার পদ্ধতি
modules.content: To check National University results online, students can visit https://results.nu.ac.bd/ or http://www.nu.ac.bd/results/ and http://103.113.200.7/. Select course (Honours, Degree, Masters, Professional), enter Roll Number, Registration Number, Examination Year, solve captcha, and click Search Result. For SMS results, send to 16222 from any mobile phone using the format: Honours: 'NU H1/H2/H3/H4 Roll' -> 16222; Degree: 'NU DEG Roll' -> 16222; Masters Final: 'NU MF Roll' -> 16222; Masters Preliminary: 'NU MP Roll' -> 16222; Professional: 'NU HP Roll' -> 16222.

National University follows a 4.00 GPA/CGPA grading scale: 80% to 100% = A+ (4.00, Outstanding); 75% to <80% = A (3.75, Excellent); 70% to <75% = A- (3.50, Very Good); 65% to <70% = B+ (3.25, Good); 60% to <65% = B (3.00, Satisfactory); 55% to <60% = B- (2.75, Above Average); 50% to <55% = C+ (2.50, Average); 45% to <50% = C (2.25, Below Average); 40% to <45% = D (2.00, Pass); Below 40% = F (0.00, Fail). Minimum passing CGPA required for degree completion is 2.00.

Undergraduate admission (Honours 4-year, Degree Pass 3-year, Professional) is conducted online via http://app11.nu.edu.bd/ without any written admission test. Merit is calculated from SSC (40%) and HSC (60%) results. Candidates not selected in the 1st or 2nd merit list can apply for 1st Release Slip and 2nd Release Slip across up to 5 colleges and subjects.

modules.topic: Examination, Form Fill-up and Promotion Rules
modules.topic_bn: পরীক্ষা, ফর্ম পূরণ ও প্রমোশন নিয়মাবলী
modules.content: Online examination form fill-up is hosted on http://ems.nu.ac.bd/. Honours students must pass minimum required courses per academic year (at least 3 theoretical courses in 1st/2nd year, 4 courses in 3rd year) with a minimum GPA of 2.00 to be promoted to the next academic session. Improvement examination is allowed for courses with 'C', 'D', or 'F' grades during the immediate subsequent regular examination session (grade capped at B+ for C and D improvements).

modules.topic: Answer Script Re-scrutiny and Board Challenge
modules.content: Students unsatisfied with published results can apply for answer script re-scrutiny (খাতা পুনর্নিরীক্ষণ) online on https://www.nu.ac.bd/ within 30 calendar days of result publication. Fees are payable through Sonali Bank Sonali Seba. Results of re-scrutiny are published on the official notice board within 30 to 45 days.

Transfer Certificate (TC) applications are submitted online through the Student Services portal http://103.113.200.68/nu-app/. TC is only allowed in the identical subject and academic year where vacant approved seats exist in the destination college, with mutual clearance. Simultaneous subject change during college transfer is prohibited.

Original Registration Cards are issued by National University to affiliated colleges after 1st-year admission. For Name Correction, Father's/Mother's Name Correction, Date of Birth Correction, and Duplicate Registration Cards, students apply online via http://103.113.200.68/nu-app/ with academic certificates and fee payment via Sonali Seba.

Original Degree Certificates, Provisional Certificates, Academic Transcripts, Migration Certificates, and WES / International Verification are applied online via http://103.113.200.68/nu-app/. Fees are paid through Sonali Seba e-pay slips.

The Chancellor of the National University of Bangladesh is the Honorable President of the People's Republic of Bangladesh. The Vice-Chancellor (VC / উপাচার্য) of National University is Professor Dr. A. S. M. Amanullah (প্রফেসর ড. এ এস এম আমানুল্লাহ). The Pro-Vice Chancellors (উপ-উপাচার্য) are Prof. Md. Lutfor Rahaman and Professor Dr. Mohammad Ali Zinnah. The Treasurer (কোষাধ্যক্ষ) is Professor Dr. Md. Nazmul Hossain / Prof. Dr. A. T. M. Zafrul Azam. Main administrative headquarters is located in Board Bazar, Gazipur 1704. Central Registrar contact: registrar@nu.ac.bd.

Official degree certificates, provisional certificates, and academic transcripts can be verified online through the National University Certificate Verification portal at https://www.nu.ac.bd/certificate-verification.php and the student service portal http://103.113.200.68/nu-app/.

modules.topic: e-Payment and PAMS Services (Re-Evaluation, Dormitory, On-Campus Payslip, Payment Check)
modules.content: The National University e-Payment (PAMS) portal at http://103.113.200.36/PAMS/Default.aspx hosts key academic and administrative payment services: 1. Re-Evaluation Fee (http://103.113.200.36/PAMS/ICTUnit/Re-Evaluation.aspx) for answer sheet re-evaluation for BBA, PGD in LIS, AMT, FDT, KMT and other semester programs. 2. Exam Centre Change for examination centre transfer applications and fees. 3. Dormitory Reservation (http://103.113.200.36/PAMS/Dormitory/Reservation.aspx) for teachers, researchers, trainees, resource persons, retired employees, foreign guests, and university personnel to book guest rooms and pay via Sonali Bank. 4. On-Campus Payslip (http://103.113.200.36/PAMS/ICTUnit/OnCampusPayslip.aspx) for main campus students to download registration and semester fee pay slips. 5. Check Payment (http://103.113.200.36/PAMS/ICTUnit/PaymentChk.aspx) to verify Sonali Seba payment status using NU TransID, Bank Ref No, Roll or Registration number.
